mechanism_narrative: The week-on-week rebound in RETAIL_REC decayed from +6.9 points (t-3w to t-1w) to +0.7 points (t-1w to t-0w) while RESIDENTIAL remained +11.4 above baseline, so the reopening impulse is exhausting itself and the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean stays below its last-28-day mean of -27.35.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds -27.35, the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has printed below -50 percent change from baseline for four consecutive weeks; because discretionary retail trips in Melbourne depend on the transit network, a deficit of that depth caps trip generation and stops RETAIL_REC from returning toward baseline over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean stays below -50 percent change from baseline for a fourth consecutive week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT = -51.0 at t-0w, fourth straight week below -50
failure_condition: Next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is higher than the last-28-day mean while TRANSIT remains below -50.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES have decoupled (TRANSIT -51.0 versus WORKPLACES -21.1), so the commute chain that anchors weekday and after-work retail visits is broken; a workplace rebound without a matching transit rebound cannot convert into retail footfall over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves by at least 10 points while TRANSIT improves by less than 3 points in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean rises above the last-28-day mean while the TRANSIT-WORKPLACES gap widens further.

mechanism_narrative: In a renewed-tightening regime RETAIL_REC re-couples to policy stringency: PARKS falling from -12.3 to -21.4 and GROCERY_PHARM normalization stalling at -1.7 mark the onset of a second-wave regime in which retail visits slide back toward their April trough over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 5 points week-on-week while the RETAIL_REC weekly improvement stalls below 1 point
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -12.3 at t-1w to -21.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean exceeds -27.35 while PARKS stays below -20.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has converged to baseline (-1.7 versus -4.1 four weeks earlier), showing precautionary stockpiling has ended; as grocery runs stop substituting for discretionary shopping, household spend rotates back into retail and recreation within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays within 2 points of baseline for two consecutive weeks
regime_hint: reopening with low perceived infection risk
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is at or below the last-28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM stays within 2 points of baseline.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility is winter- and weather-driven, and its swing to -12.3 then back to -21.4 tracks Melbourne conditions; whenever PARKS sits above -20, outdoor leisure absorbs the discretionary time and spend that would otherwise reach shops, depressing RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises above -20 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS = -12.3 at t-1w, above the -20 threshold
regime_hint: winter seasonal with outdoor activity permitted
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases week-on-week in weeks when PARKS is above -20.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL remains +11.4 above baseline and is decaying by only about 1.5 points per week, so a persistent share of residents is still staying home; this residual home-confinement level suppresses retail trip generation and holds the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean below the last-28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL decayed from 15.9 to 11.4 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean rises above -27.35 while RESIDENTIAL stays above +8.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES recovered from -32.3 to -21.1 across the window, and each 10-point workplace recovery pulls retail footfall up as commuting, lunch and after-work spending resume; the next four weeks therefore print a RETAIL_REC mean above -27.35 once WORKPLACES holds above -25.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean rises above -25 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is at or below -27.35 while WORKPLACES holds above -25.
